specs.label: AI by Recorder
specs.value: Face detection; face recognition; video metadata (human, motor vehicles, and non-motor vehicles); perimeter protection; SMD Plus; AcuPick; WizSeek; Text-Defined Alarm

specs.label: Performance
specs.value: 1. Compatible with cameras that support AcuPick/IVS/Metadata, it can meet full-channel WizSeek （Max 4 targets per sec） 2. Modeling capability: up to 345,600 targets per day

specs.label: Face Attributes
specs.value: Gender; age group; glasses; expressions; face mask; beard

specs.label: Face Database Capacity
specs.value: Up to 20 face databases with 30,000 images, with a total capacity of 3.75 GB. Name, gender, birthday, address, credential type, credential No., countries & regions and state can be added to each face image.

specs.label: SMD Plus by Recorder
specs.value: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

specs.label: People Attributes
specs.value: Top color, top type, bottom color, bottom type, hat, bag, age, gender and umbrella

specs.label: Motor Vehicle Attributes
specs.value: License plate, plate color, vehicle body, vehicle model, vehicle logo, calling, seatbelt, vehicle interior, vehicle registration location

specs.label: Non-motor Vehicle Attributes
specs.value: Vehicle model, vehicle color, number of persons, helmet

specs.label: License Plate Database Capacity
specs.value: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers. 2. Blocklist and allowlist
